notes.title: PBBGU - Patch V.1.04.4141
notes.notes: [p][/p][h3]Gameplay Adjustments & Balancing[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted enemy AI patterns and overall balance in DLC stages (especially on Easy/Normal).[/p][/*][*][p]Refined boss mechanics and event timing to improve flow and prevent progression locks.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted enemy attack frequency and damage values in several DLC encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Skill loadout available during co-op play (result screen)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain bosses or mid-bosses could get stuck or fail to appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved camera and UI misalignment during Battle Ground and event scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a progression blocker caused by client disconnects or stage transitions in online play.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected missing shadows and background assets in some DLC stages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple crashes related to online lobbies, session cleanup, and character select transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed boss retreat events not resetting the camera to default view.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug where characters could remain controllable in a KO state after area changes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed errors when reconnecting to lobbies or attempting to join full sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed various localization errors and profile card asset issues.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Online / Networking Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Improved session stability across all platforms (PS4/PS5, Xbox, Switch, Steam, Epic).[/p][/*][*][p]Better session cleanup when a host disconnects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lobby hang-ups and sync issues after returning from character select.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved handling of client disconnects so remaining players update correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Added better timeout and kick logic for inactive/missing player input.[/p][/*][*][p]Refined error recovery and session logic across platforms.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’ve fixed a lot with this update, and more improvements are on the way. Thanks for sticking with us and sharing your feedback![/p][p][/p][p]- The Rocket Panda Games Team[/p]

notes.title: PBBGU - Patch V.1.03.3459
notes.notes:
Hey Players!

Thanks for continuing to battle with us in Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate! This hotfix rolls out a handful of key improvements and bug fixes to keep your experience running smooth and solid:

[u][b]Enemy Clearing Fix[/b][/u]
[i]Resolved an issue where certain enemies weren’t being properly counted, which could prevent progression in some areas.[/i]

[u][b]Ranking Display Tweak[/b][/u]
[i]The leaderboard now correctly caps at 999 entries as originally intended. Keep climbing and make your mark among the top![/i]

[u][b]Steam Offline Launch Support[/b][/u]
[i]The game now boots normally on Steam while offline—as long as your Steam client is running.[/i]

[u][b]Throw Attack Adjustments[/b][/u]
[i]Fixed an issue where enemies could become stuck after being hit with a strike throw.
If a character is damaged mid-throw, the game now handles it correctly without freezing.
[/i]
[u][b]Additional Stability Updates[/b][/u]
[i]Improved error handling to prevent edge-case progression blockers and online play disruptions.[/i]

Thanks again for all the support and feedback—you help us keep pushing PB:BGU to the next level! 

Happy gaming,

[i]- The Rocket Panda Team 🐼[/i]
